title: MetadataSet
description: A set of metadata fields (system and custom). This standalone schema carries field definitions, including data types and allowed values, independently from assets. A field may also carry a value as open extra data; this schema does not define that value's representation.

set_id.description: Unique identifier for the metadata set.

label.description: Human-readable label for the metadata set.

type.description: Data type of the field. Use 'enum' when values come from a fixed list of allowed values.

enum_values.description: Allowed values if type is enum.

multi_select.description: Cardinality for type 'enum'. If true, the field can hold more than one allowed value. If false or omitted, it holds one value. This schema does not define how multiple values are represented. Applies only to type 'enum'.

schema_version.description: Version of the metadata set schema used to create this record. Follows semantic versioning (e.g., '1.0.0'). Optional but recommended for evolution and compatibility checks.

extensions.description: Extension point for custom fields or plugin data. Keys SHOULD be prefixed with 'x_' or 'custom_' to avoid collision with future standard fields.
